name: Buttery Shell Pasta with Chicken, Broccoli & Parmesan

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap). Add salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, uncover, add pasta, and stir for a few seconds; cook until starting to soften, 6-7 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tsp salt
10 oz pasta shells, medium-size

instructions.primary_message: While the pasta is cooking, wash, dry, and separate broccoli into bite-sized florets; cut stems into smaller pieces.

When the pasta is starting to soften, add broccoli to the pot. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until pasta reaches desired firmness and broccoli is tender, 2-3 minutes more. Drain pasta and broccoli, then set aside. (Reserve a ¼-cup pasta water before draining.)
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken dry with paper towels and cut into bite-sized pieces. Season with spices.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
¾ tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper
¼ tsp garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown and cooked through, 6-7 minutes.

When the chicken is done, add cooked pasta, broccoli, reserved pasta cooking water, and Parmesan to the skillet, then stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring frequently, until pasta is warmed through and cheese is melted, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls and enjoy!
